reason: OutboxNotifier.send has its parameters in the order (subject, address, body), so it does not satisfy the Notifier port's send(address, subject, body).
EventBus.unsubscribe is a no-op, which is a behavioural bug, but the layering, injection and encapsulation requirements are all kept.
The _announce helper still publishes through the injected bus and the appointment is changed only via cancel(); the architecture is unchanged.
Differently organised modules, but layering is respected, handlers use only the BookingService and ReminderService, adapters are built only in wiring and Appointment is encapsulated.
Only the in-memory id counter changes (itertools.count); the architecture is unchanged.
